name: Honey Harissa Trout with Chickpeas & Lime Yoghurt
steps: Mix harissa and honey together. Rub half over the trout fillet and season well.
Heat oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Fry chickpeas with garlic and remaining harissa mix for 4 min until slightly crispy.
Push chickpeas to the side. Add trout skin-side down and cook 3–4 min, flip and cook 1–2 min more. Remove and rest.
Stir spinach through the chickpeas until wilted.
Mix yoghurt with lime zest, lime juice and a pinch of salt.
Serve trout over chickpeas with a generous dollop of lime yoghurt.
